description_en: Call the ListFolders operation to query for folders
description_zh: 调用ListFolders查询文件夹的列表
name: ListFolders

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. Log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the workspace ID. You must set either this parameter or ProjectIdentifier to specify the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks管控台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。该参数与ProjectIdentifier参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataWorks workspace. Log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the workspace name. You must set either this parameter or ProjectId to specify the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间名称。您可以登录DataWorks控制台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间名称。该参数与ProjectId参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en: The path of the parent folder
parameters.name: parent_folder_path

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. This parameter is used for pagination
parameters.help_zh: 请求的数据页数，用于翻页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The default value is 10. The maximum value is 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的数据条数，默认为10条，最大为100条
parameters.name: page_size
